script: Your dog isn't hungry. Your dog is running a thirty thousand year old con on you, and it's working. The ancestors of modern dogs survived by scavenging near human camps, and the ones who could read our faces best got fed first. That skill got passed down and sharpened over thousands of generations, to the point where dogs today can track your eyes, read your micro-expressions, and time the exact moment you're most likely to cave. That sad, focused stare isn't random either, it actually triggers a small oxytocin release in you, the same bonding hormone that makes you melt at a baby's face. Dogs didn't evolve to beg loudly, they evolved to look pathetic enough that you hand over the food yourself. It's not manipulation exactly, it's ten thousand years of very effective evolution.
